We hit some unexpected internal delays (security review and networking setup) and the pilot isn't generating good signal yet. - Extension: 30 days (trial end moved to 2027-07-12).
- We're also asking for an introductory 10% discount on the first paid invoice should we convert in the next 60 days.

I've attached a usage report and a short note from our CTO to explain the delay. We're committed to proving value quickly once infra is unblocked.

Attachments: usage_report_q1.csv (summary)

Would appreciate a quick yes/no so we can prioritize the remaining work.

Best,
Lara Chen

Folks — forwarding PioneerAI's ask. TL;DR: they request $15k in trial credits, a 30-day extension, and a one-time 10% discount on the first paid invoice if they convert within 60 days. Pilot is generating signals but blocked by a security/networking gate.

Why this matters: PioneerAI is an AI-native startup with a potential mid-market expansion path. If we get the pilot properly instrumented, conversion odds improve materially.

My proposed compromise: approve up to $10k credit + 30-day extension unconditionally; reserve the extra $5k contingent on a 3–6 month committed spend (we can structure as a short reserved capacity commitment or discount-backed MPA). Discount can be 7% one-time if they sign within 45 days. That reduces our upfront cost while giving them runway.

Requested: Marissa — executive approval for the $10k unconditional credit and the 30-day extension; Neha — finance signoff to confirm we can do a 7% one-time discount and how to capture the credit on billing. Sean — CS help to own the mutual action plan and ensure we get the telemetry once infra is up.

Attachments: Pioneer usage_report_q1.csv, draft SOW link (see HubSpot).

Thanks — Rishi
